certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Railway is now SOC 2 Type II compliant, which means our systems, processes, and controls meet a high, generally accepted security posture bar.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: Railway is SOC 2 Type II certified and SOC 3 certified.

certifications.name: HIPAA Attestation
certifications.proof_quote: Railway follows a shared responsibility model for HIPAA compliance and PHI. BAAs and penetration test reports are available upon request.

certifications.name: GDPR (DPA + EU SCCs)
certifications.proof_quote: Railway provides a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) to help customers comply with GDPR requirements.

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Company may transfer Personal Data processed under this DPA outside the EEA... pursuant to (i) the Data Privacy Framework to the extent the recipient of the ex-EEA Transfer is certified accordingly.

certifications.name: Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Data Privacy Framework means, as applicable, EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, and/or the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.source: No evidence found on trust.railway.com, docs.railway.com/enterprise/compliance, or in any Railway legal pages as of 2026-06-27.

privacy.ai_training_note: Railway's DPA explicitly states: 'Company shall not: (i) sell or share Personal Data; (ii) retain, use, or disclose Personal Data outside of Company's direct business relationship with Customer or for any purpose other than as necessary to perform the Services.' Railway is a cloud infrastructure platform (PaaS); customer workloads and application data run on Railway's infrastructure but no clause or policy indicates Railway trains AI or ML models on customer deployment data or application code.
privacy.data_region: US-primary (Google Cloud Platform). DPA states: 'Customer acknowledges that Company's primary processing operations take place in the United States.' Some local data storage options available for paid-tier customers.

security.name: Infrastructure provider
security.value: Google Cloud Platform (GCP); separate production environment

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Implemented; disk encryption confirmed for endpoint devices

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: SSL/TLS enforced; 100 Gbps internal networking with private, encrypted connections

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Independent penetration test conducted; report available on request via trust.railway.com

security.name: Bug bounty program
security.value: Self-managed (not HackerOne or Bugcrowd). Submit to bugbounty@railway.com; rewards calculated by CVSS 3.1; paid within 30 days of acceptance. Program policy: https://railway.com/bug-bounty-program.pdf

security.name: Network security
security.value: Firewall, DNS filtering, traffic filtering, DDoS protection, spoofing protection, endpoint detection and response (EDR)

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC), SSO (enterprise tier), audit logging, restricted data access level

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Five documented subprocessors: Fathom Analytics, Cloudflare, Causal, Customer.io, Stripe. Full list at trust.railway.com/item/subprocessors. 10-day advance notice required before adding new subprocessors.

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: All data interactions logged; audit logs available on enterprise tier

products.name: Hobby
products.data_scope: $5/month for solo developers and side projects. No compliance add-ons. Basic deploy, network, and monitoring features.
products.notes: Not suitable for regulated workloads or enterprise compliance requirements.

products.name: Pro
products.data_scope: $20/month per seat for production teams. Includes team collaboration, multiple environments, and usage-based scaling.
products.notes: DPA available; SOC 2 report accessible via Trust Center. HIPAA BAA and SSO require Enterprise upgrade.

products.name: Enterprise
products.data_scope: Custom pricing. Includes HIPAA BAA (minimum ~$1,000/month commitment), SSO, RBAC, audit logs, contractual SLAs, dedicated support, private networking.
products.notes: Designed for regulated industries (healthcare, finance). HIPAA is shared-responsibility: Railway provides BAA and infrastructure controls; customer is responsible for application-layer PHI safeguards.

compare.pricing_model: Usage-based with tier minimums: Hobby $5/mo, Pro $20/seat/mo, Enterprise custom (minimum ~$1,000/mo for HIPAA BAA)
compare.data_residency: US-primary (GCP). Regional options exist for paid tiers but are not fully documented publicly. Contact sales for specific region availability.

flags: HIPAA BAA is a paid add-on requiring Enterprise tier (minimum ~$1,000/month); shared responsibility model applies.
Bug bounty is self-managed (not on HackerOne/Bugcrowd), which offers less researcher visibility but is still a formal program.
No ISO 27001 certification found as of 2026-06-27.
SOC 2 Type II achieved August 2025 - relatively recent certification; Type I had been achieved in July 2024.
AI features (Railway Agent, MCP Server) do not include an explicit AI-training-on-customer-data opt-out clause, but Railway's core DPA prohibits using customer data outside service delivery.
